text:
Maya Chen: Kicking off IslandTel edge cluster bring-up in eu-central-2 (private/VPC, air-gapped). Need a quick run-through of blockers and a handoff plan.
Liam O'Connor: Thanks — main bullets: seed image delivery, HSM/KMS setup, customer firewall rules, MTU/Jumbo frames validation, GPU SKU confirmation.
Samir Patel: Also confirm BGP peering window with their network team — they do route filtering on our ASN which caused issues last time.
Sophie Lee: I'll own the seed ISO and image signing. ETA for signed image tarball is today EOD.
Maya Chen: Perfect. @Sophie can you post the signed SHA and upload path once done? We need to give the site ops engineer a URL and checksum for offline pull.
Sophie Lee: Uploaded to S3 presigned URL (transferred via secure ticket). SHA256: 3f7a2b9e... (sent over ticket).
Samir Patel: For firewall rules, customer needs outbound to our control-plane IPs and TCP 6443 inbound from site admin network. Also allow NTP (UDP 123) and CRL/OCSP to our cert servers.
Maya Chen: Noted. We also require ephemeral port range 30000-32767 for nodePort testing during validation.
Liam O'Connor: GPU pool: customer requested cost-optimized A10G nodes but will want occasional A100 bursts. Plan: 8x A10G for steady state + 2x A100 burst nodes in a dedicated taint group. Can we fit that in their rack power?
Oncall DevOps: Customer PDUs confirmed for A10G baseline. A100s will push high power draw, need 2x redundant PDUs per rack if added.
Maya Chen: Good catch. I'll put A100s behind a canary flag and do a power smoke test first.
Samir Patel: Air-gapped steps checklist (short):
1) Ship signed image + checksum to customer ticket
2) Customer verifies checksum and writes to local registry
3) Seed controller node boots from ISO and runs join token
4) Pull operator images from local registry
5) Configure KMS/HSM tunnel (if HSM local, ensure PKCS11 driver and plugin config)
Include snippet we used last time:```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: redwood-kms-config
data:
  pkcs11Lib: "/usr/local/lib/softhsm2.so"
  slot: "0"
```
Liam O'Connor: Also ensure local time sync. We had cert issues when site NTP drift > 300s. Add this to the prereq checklist.
Maya Chen: Adding NTP verification step to validation playbook.
Sophie Lee: During image import we saw MTU mismatches earlier; set docker / containerd to 1400 if customer uses 9000 on underlay to avoid fragmentation. Command we run:```bash
sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
sudo ip link set dev eth0 mtu 1400
```
Oncall DevOps: If they insist on jumbo frames, we need to validate switch configs and VXLAN MTU end-to-end. Mark that as 'requires network engineer on call'.
Maya Chen: For canary validation, test plan:
- node registration + taints/labels check
- run perfbench with tokenized throughput target 450 tokens/s per A10G replica
- end-to-end latency check via our smoke client (1k queries over 10 minutes)
- storage IO test for KV cache warmup
Samir Patel: Share the perfbench command:```bash
perfbench --model=https://local-registry/islandtel/redwood-quant:latest --concurrency=8 --seq-len=1024 --duration=600
```
Liam O'Connor: Cost note for handoff: estimated baseline monthly GPU hours: 8 A10G * 720h + occasional A100 bursts (~50h). I'll draft cost projection and include delta for quantized vs full precision.
Maya Chen: Draft looks good — include a TTL for burst nodes so they auto-terminate if unused for 2 days.
Sophie Lee: Handoff to SE and customer ops: schedule a 1-hour session post-canary for credentials, rollout policy explanation, and emergency rollback runbook. Proposed timeslot: tomorrow 10:00 CET.
Oncall DevOps: I'll be present for the first hour of boot to handle network flaps. Please @mention me in the runbook when you update it.
Maya Chen: Will do. Final prechecks before seed: certs uploaded, signed image present, NTP, firewall rule list confirmed, PDU/IB power ok, local registry reachable. Anything else?
Samir Patel: Add kernel parameter for hugepages if they plan large batch sizes: vm.nr_hugepages=2048.
Liam O'Connor: And GPU driver compatibility matrix: CUDA 11.8 + driver 535 validated for both A10G and A100 in our runtime. Include that in the image release notes.
Maya Chen: Great. I'll run the checklist now and post a short progress thread. infra-bot: create runbook stub?
infra-bot: Runbook "islandtel-edge-onboard" created at https://internal.docs/runbooks/islandtel-edge-onboard (access: eng-infra, se).
Sophie Lee: Uploaded signed image doc and MTU notes to the runbook.
Maya Chen: Thanks everyone — moving to execution. Will ping here with the post-canary status. :white_check_mark:
Oncall DevOps: If anything hits networking weirdness, call me on pager afterwards.
Maya Chen: Acknowledged.
